7492-the-fighting-chance.title: The Fighting Chance
7492-the-fighting-chance.creator: Robert W. Chambers
7492-the-fighting-chance.description: A book by Robert W. Chambers. Sunshine blazed on foliage plants arranged geometrically, on scarlet stars composed of geraniums, on thickets of tall flame-tinted cannas. And around this triumph of landscape gardening, phaeton, Tilbury, Mercedes, and Toledo backed, circled, tooted; gaily gowned women, whips aslant, horses dancing, greeted expected guests; laughing young men climbed into dog-carts and took the reins from nimble grooms; young girls, extravagantly veiled, made room in comfortable touring-cars for feminine guests whose extravagant veils were yet to be unpacked; slim young men in leather trappings, caps

78847-as-a-woman-thinks.title: Woman Thinks
78847-as-a-woman-thinks.creator: Corra Harris
78847-as-a-woman-thinks.description: A book by Corra Harris. This is not a mystical tale, nor a literary interpretation of addled-egg metaphysics. The mind I have has always been laid off sensibly according to the latitudes and longitudes of actual experiences in this present world. I never had an aura, nor the least confidence in the existence of an oversoul.

arxiv-2103-16948.title: pivmet : Pivotal Methods for Bayesian Relabelling and k k -Means Clustering
arxiv-2103-16948.creator: Leonardo Egidi a , Roberta Pappadà a , Francesco Pauli a and Nicola Torelli a
arxiv-2103-16948.description: Abstract The identification of groups’ prototypes, i.e. elements of a dataset that represent different groups of data points, may be relevant to the tasks of clustering, classification and mixture modeling. The R package pivmet presented in this paper includes different methods for extracting pivotal units from a dataset.

arxiv-2106-00223.title: Axion model with the SU ⁡ ( 6 ) {\rm SU}(6) unification
arxiv-2106-00223.creator: Ning Chen, Yutong Liu, Zhaolong Teng
arxiv-2106-00223.description: Abstract We propose an SU ⁡ ( 6 ) {\rm SU}(6) unified theory that solves the strong CP problem with a high-quality axion. This is achieved by an automatic global Peccei-Quinn U ​ ( 1 ) PQ \rm U(1)_{\rm PQ} symmetry and the gauged discrete ℤ 4 ​ ℛ \mathbb{Z}_{4\mathcal{R}} symmetry.

arxiv-2111-08685.title: A Latent Encoder Coupled Generative Adversarial Network (LE-GAN) for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Super-resolution
arxiv-2111-08685.creator: Yue Shi, Liangxiu Han*, Lianghao Han, Sheng Chang, Tongle Hu, Darren Dancey
arxiv-2111-08685.description: Abstract Realistic hyperspectral image (HSI) super-resolution (SR) techniques aim to generate a high-resolution (HR) HSI with higher spectral and spatial fidelity from its low-resolution (LR) counterpart. The generative adversarial network (GAN) has proven to be an effective deep learning framework for image super-resolution.

arxiv-2301-01720.title: Augmenting data-driven models for energy systems through feature engineering: A Python framework for feature engineering
arxiv-2301-01720.creator: Sandra Wilfling
arxiv-2301-01720.description: Abstract Data-driven modeling is an approach in energy systems modeling that has been gaining popularity. In data-driven modeling, machine learning methods such as linear regression, neural networks or decision-tree based methods are being applied. While these methods do not require domain knowledge, they are sensitive to data quality.

arxiv-2307-06356.title: Transmission spectroscopy of the lowest-density gas giant: metals and a potential extended outflow in HAT-P-67b batman ( Kreidberg 2015 ) , corner ( Foreman-Mackey 2016 ) , emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 ) , FastChem ( Stock et al. 2018 ) , HELIOS-K ( Grimm et al. 2021 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 20
arxiv-2307-06356.creator: Aaron Bello-Arufe, Heather A. Knutson, João M. Mendonça, Michael M. Zhang, Samuel H. C. Cabot, Alexander D. Rathcke, Ana Ulla, Shreyas Vissapragada, Lars A. Buchhave
arxiv-2307-06356.description: Abstract Extremely low-density exoplanets are tantalizing targets for atmospheric characterization because of their promisingly large signals in transmission spectroscopy. We present the first analysis of the atmosphere of the lowest-density gas giant currently known, HAT-P-67b. This inflated Saturn-mass exoplanet sits at the boundary between hot and ultrahot gas giants, where thermal dissociation of molecules begins to dominate atmospheric composition.

arxiv-2309-09522.title: TOPr: Enhanced Static Code Pruning for Fast and Precise Directed Fuzzing
arxiv-2309-09522.creator: Chaitra Niddodi, Stefan Nagy, Darko Marinov, Sibin Mohan
arxiv-2309-09522.description: Abstract Directed fuzzing is a dynamic testing technique that focuses exploration on specific, pre-targeted program locations. Like other types of fuzzers, directed fuzzers are most effective when maximizing testing speed and precision. To this end, recent directed fuzzers have begun leveraging path pruning : preventing the wasteful testing of program paths deemed irrelevant to reaching a desired target location.

arxiv-2311-06919.title: Thermodynamics and Tachyon Condensation of the Dressed-Dynamical Unstable D p p -branes
arxiv-2311-06919.description: Abstract Using the boundary state formalism and thermo field dynamics approach, we study a D p p -brane at finite temperature in which the background Kalb-Ramond field, a U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge potential, and tachyon field are turned on together with a general tangential dynamics. The thermal entropy of the brane will be studied.

arxiv-2311-10440.title: Parallel Verification of Natural Deduction Proof Graphs
arxiv-2311-10440.creator: James T. Oswald Brandon Rozek
arxiv-2311-10440.description: Abstract Graph-based interactive theorem provers offer a visual representation of proofs, explicitly representing the dependencies and inferences between each of the proof steps in a graph or hypergraph format. The number and complexity of these dependency links can determine how long it takes to verify the validity of the entire proof.

arxiv-2312-04316.title: Towards Knowledge-driven Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2312-04316.creator: Xin Li, Yeqi Bai, Pinlong Cai, Licheng Wen, Daocheng Fu, Bo Zhang, Xuemeng Yang, Xinyu Cai, Tao Ma, Jianfei Guo, Xing Gao, Min Dou, Yikang Li, Botian Shi, Yong Liu, Liang He, Yu Qiao
arxiv-2312-04316.description: Abstract This paper explores the emerging knowledge-driven autonomous driving technologies. Our investigation highlights the limitations of current autonomous driving systems, in particular their sensitivity to data bias, difficulty in handling long-tail scenarios, and lack of interpretability. Conversely, knowledge-driven methods with the abilities of cognition, generalization and life-long learning emerge as a promising way to overcome these challenges.

arxiv-2506-22829.title: Cluster analysis of earthquake hypocenters in Azerbaijan and surrounding territories
arxiv-2506-22829.creator: Sergii Skurativskyi
arxiv-2506-22829.description: Abstract Abstract. The research focuses on seismic events that occurred in Azerbaijan and adjacent territories, regions known for strong seismic activity. We analyze a catalog of recorded earthquakes between 2010 and 2023, extracting the locations of the earthquake hypocenters for study purposes. Using statistical methods and cluster analysis tools, we developed a procedure for partitioning hypocenter clusters.

pmc-10687858.title: Nuclear Quantum Effects Made Accessible: Local Density Fitting in Multicomponent Methods
pmc-10687858.creator: Lukas Hasecke, Ricardo A Mata
pmc-10687858.description: The simulation of nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) is crucial for an accurate description of systems and processes involving light nuclei, such as hydrogen atoms. Within the last years, the importance of those effects has been highlighted for a vast range of systems with tremendous implications in chemistry, biology, physics, and materials sciences.

pmc-11379035.title: Exploring the Health Literacy Behavior Patterns of Male Patients Using an Interpretable Method
pmc-11379035.creator: Lizhen Huang, Yanjun Jin, Ching-Wen Chien, Qinyi Xu, Yen-Ching Chuang, Tao-Hsin Tung
pmc-11379035.description: BackgroundImproving overall and individual health literacy is a major focus of national initiatives in China and similar initiatives globally. However, few studies have examined the identification and improvement of individual health literacy levels, especially among patients.PurposeTo develop an interpretable method with decision rules to assess the health literacy levels of male patients and identify key factors influencing health literacy levels.

pmc-11536506.title: Editorial: Anti-inflammatory diet in autoimmune diseases
pmc-11536506.creator: Ifigenia Kostoglou-Athanassiou, Panagiotis Athanassiou
pmc-11536506.description: It has also been studied extensively in the context of inflammatory bowel disease (5). Dietary factors may prevent or ameliorate rheumatoid arthritis (6). In this Research Topic we aimed to study the effect of dietary factors which may have anti-inflammatory properties in the prevention and management of autoimmune diseases.

pmc-12504445.title: Anston attentional network for structured data based stroke risk prediction in smart aging
pmc-12504445.creator: Feng Zhou, Shijing Hu, Xiaozheng Du, Zhihui Lu
pmc-12504445.description: To reduce the pressure on public health services caused by the aging population, nursing homes need to predict disease risks for the elderly periodically. To improve the disease risks predicting ability of nursing homes, we designed Anston (An Attention Mechanism Network Model for Structured Data Classification) in the application scenario of innovative elderly care.

pmc-13100022.title: Quieting the Storm: Hypoxia as a Strategy to Boost UC-MSC Therapies for Hypoxic-Ischemic Brain Lesions in Neonatal Rats
pmc-13100022.creator: Inês Serrenho, Vera Mendes, Inês Caramelo, Carla M. P. Cardoso, Bruno Manadas, Graça Baltazar
pmc-13100022.description: BackgroundIntegrating stem cell therapies into clinical settings faces several challenges, particularly in achieving the high cell yields necessary for attaining therapeutic doses. Preconditioning with hypoxic conditions has shown promise in enhancing the mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)’ reparative capabilities of the central nervous system.
